item.title: Cowboy Tales – The Heifers
item.description: I was helping gather a bunch of heifers at the Diamond T Ranch in the Nebraska sandhills, the first part of March. It was a balmy 35 degrees, and we had to dodge ice and snowdrifts. item.title: NCBA and PLC Deliver Lesser Prairie-Chicken Delisting
item.description: Today, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) finalized removal of the Northern and Southern Distinct Population Segments (DPS) of lesser prairie-chicken from the Endangered Species Act (ESA) list. item.description: A recent change just occurred at the Environmental Protection Agency, a change that was overlooked by many in the craziness that has become the average American news cycle.
